overview:
It’s getting seriously close at the summit, with just four points separating the top two! Mcginning to believe holds on to first place with 728 points, despite a relatively quiet 27-point week. DuncanDisorder also stays put in second, picking up 39 points to close the gap to just four points. MattyCashInTheAttic remains third on 711, keeping the pressure on the leaders. The biggest movers were Krusty's Blue Moon, climbing two places into 4th, and Richmond FC, also rising two spots to 13th after a useful 46-point return. Livesdownthelaine moved up one place into 9th with the week's best score of 51 points. Meanwhile, Dragospear's XI and Gayfield of Dreams each slipped one place, while Not too shabbyAlonso dropped out of the top ten. At the bottom, 79th time lucky climbed above Kp nuts, who now occupy 22nd. It was a fairly modest scoring week for most, but with only four points at the top, the title race is well and truly on!

The Premier League delivered some big results and a few serious FPL talking points, with 30 goals across the ten matches. The headline result was Liverpool's emphatic 4-0 win over Manchester United, with Florian Wirtz among the goals and collecting 14 FPL points. Leeds also stunned Chelsea with a 4-1 victory at Stamford Bridge, while Brentford matched Liverpool's four-goal margin by thrashing Everton 4-0. Arsenal were held to a 2-2 draw at Newcastle, and Manchester City could only manage a 1-1 draw with Fulham. There were further surprises as Hull beat Brighton 2-0 and Bournemouth defeated Nottingham Forest by the same scoreline. Tottenham got the job done with a 2-0 win over Ipswich, while Aston Villa and Sunderland played out a goalless draw. With Liverpool and Brentford defenders enjoying big returns and some popular teams taking a beating, GW11 certainly gave FPL managers plenty to think about!
